response.title: which portable solar panel makes the most power for how small it folds
response.answer:
If you're looking for a portable solar panel that produces the most watts while folding into the smallest possible package, the key metric is:

Power density when folded = Rated watts ÷ Folded volume (liters).

A 200W panel that folds to the size of a laptop can be a better choice than a 400W panel that folds into a large suitcase.

There are three things worth comparing: folded volume, weight, and rated power. Some ultralight panels sacrifice durability to achieve exceptionally compact folded dimensions.

Best candidates I found
Shop
Best power-to-packed-volume candidate

Renogy 400W Solar Blanket

400W · 16.5 × 15.8 × 4.1 in folded · 16.1 lb

~22.6 watts/liter

Extremely compact for a 400W panel. This is my strongest candidate for your specific requirement, based on published dimensions. 
Product Catalog V2025

Shop

Anker SOLIX PS400 Bifacial Portable Solar Panel

400W · approximately 22 lb

$699.99

A lighter-weight 400W alternative to many conventional folding panels. Its folded volume needs verification before ranking it against Renogy.

Shop

EcoFlow NextGen 220W Bifacial Portable Solar Panel

220W · bifacial · 25% rated cell efficiency

$449.00

Good choice for a smaller power station. Independent testing found strong power output for its portable size. 
Tested & Rated

The Renogy 400W solar blanket is particularly interesting: its published folded dimensions work out to approximately 17.7 liters, giving it a very high nominal wattage-to-volume ratio. I haven't verified that it's the absolute world leader, and the figures are manufacturer specifications rather than measured real-world output.

One question that changes the recommendation

What matters most when you say "how small it folds"?

Smallest folded volume (fits in a backpack)
Smallest folded length and width (fits in a drawer or suitcase)
Highest watts per pound
Compare for this priority
